records.title: Hierarchical Curriculum Learning for Multi-Document Reasoning in Large Language Models
records.reason: The author preprint proposes hierarchical token/fragment/document memory and curriculum fine-tuning for multi-document reasoning. It targets long contexts but the reported contribution is training/accuracy, without measured inference-cost or latency gains.

records.title: Token-Level LLM Collaboration via FusionRoute
records.reason: FusionRoute trains token-level expert selection across complementary LLMs and evaluates math, code, and instruction-following tasks. The method targets quality through collaboration; the full text provides no clear latency/throughput result and notes extra joint-training requirements.

records.title: Multi-Modal Data-Enhanced Foundation Models for Prediction and Control in Wireless Networks: A Survey
records.reason: This is a survey of multimodal foundation models for prediction/control in wireless networks. It focuses on wireless application architectures rather than LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Widget2Code: From Visual Widgets to UI Code via Multimodal LLMs
records.reason: Widget2Code uses multimodal LLMs to convert visual widgets to UI code. It is a downstream application; the primary body does not establish a token-pruning or inference-efficiency improvement despite the visual-token lineage link.

records.title: UltraFlux: Data-Model Co-Design for High-quality Native 4K Text-to-Image Generation across Diverse Aspect Ratios
records.reason: UltraFlux co-designs data/model for high-resolution text-to-image quality across aspect ratios; the paper is image-generation quality/scaling work without LLM serving efficiency.
